title: OTC Pharmaceuticals - Worldwide
highlights: The OTC Pharmaceuticals market worldwide is projected to generate a revenue of US$218.18bn by the year 2026.
It is anticipated that the market will experience an annual growth rate of 3.81% (CAGR 2026-2031).
The Cold & Cough Remedies market holds the largest market share, with a volume of US$47.09bn in 2026.
When compared globally, the United States generates the highest revenue, amounting to US$47.54bn in 2026.
On a per capita basis, the revenue generated in 2026 amounts to US$27.60 per person.
Additionally, it is estimated that online sales will contribute 24.95% of the total revenue in the OTC Pharmaceuticals market by 2026.
